name: Nonke Josou Tantei ga Gisou Shita Oiroke de Jiken no Shinsou ni Sematte Mita
original_name: ノンケ女装探偵が偽装したお色気で事件の真相に迫ってみた
source:
Four lusty men are the suspects in a crime.
A detective boy dresses up as a beautiful girl and
uses honey trap tactics to try solve the case!

* A straight boy must act accordingly.
Sometimes innocently, sometimes lewdly.
Can he perform femininely enough?

"Sorry! I only feel in the ass..."
"Sex is only for the married. How about you use my mouth...?"
